model.priceHint: US dollars per million tokens, input / output, as your workspace pays them
model.unavailable: No longer offered, uses the default

off.title: The agent is off.
off.body: Chats go straight to your team until you turn it on.

email.title: Email
email.description: Mailboxes where {{name}} answers customer emails. Turn it on or off in each mailbox's settings.
email.none: {{name}} doesn't answer emails in any mailbox yet.

behaviour.title: Behaviour
behaviour.description: How the AI agent answers chat widget visitors: what it knows, which model it uses and where it stops.
behaviour.enableHint: It replies to visitors in the chat widget, uses your tools and knowledge, and hands off to your team when it should. Replies are labelled as AI.
behaviour.identityHint: What visitors see. The picture saves as soon as you upload it.
behaviour.name: Name
behaviour.nameHint: Shown on its replies in the widget. Leave empty for Ollie.
behaviour.pictureHint: A round picture next to its replies. Without one, visitors see the Ollie mark.
behaviour.knowHint: Facts that aren't in your help center yet: products, policies, opening hours, useful links.
behaviour.instructionsHint: Write it like a note to a new teammate. The agent never invents prices, policies or order details beyond this and your knowledge.
behaviour.instructionsPlaceholder: We sell the Margin app on Free and Pro plans. Refunds within 30 days of a charge. Support hours are 9 to 6, Monday to Friday, Berlin time. Point people to margin.app/status during an outage.
behaviour.knowledgeLink: Add websites, files and snippets in Knowledge
behaviour.modelHint: A larger model answers harder questions and costs more per reply.
behaviour.widgetModelHint: Each reply costs what it uses on this model, so a pricier model or a longer conversation costs more.
behaviour.maxRepliesHint: After this many replies in one conversation the agent hands off to your team.
behaviour.guardrailsHint: Where the agent stops, and how much it may spend.
behaviour.topicsHint: The agent politely declines these and offers a person instead.
behaviour.capHint: When the agent has spent this much of the AI balance in a calendar month, it goes quiet and your team takes over. Owners and admins get one notification.
behaviour.collectEmail: Ask for an email before handing off
behaviour.collectEmailHint: When the visitor hasn't shared an email, the agent asks for one so your team can follow up.

overview.title: AI agent
overview.description: How the agent did in the chat widget: what it resolved, when it handed off, and what it couldn't answer.
overview.errorBody: Check your connection and try again.
overview.empty: No agent conversations in this range
overview.emptyBody: When the agent answers chat widget visitors, its conversations, handoffs and ratings show up here.
overview.spentHint: AI usage of the agent's replies
overview.byDayHint: Conversations the agent took part in, and how they ended.
overview.toolsHint: Calls the agent made to your connected tools.
overview.noToolsBody: Connect an MCP server so the agent can look up orders, accounts and more.
overview.gapsHint: Questions the agent couldn't answer from your knowledge.
overview.noGapsBody: Questions the agent couldn't answer will appear here, ready to become articles.

knowledge.title: Knowledge
knowledge.description: Websites, files and short answers the agent can use besides your help center. Drafts and copilot use them too.

summary.failingHint: Open a source to see why

empty.title: Teach the agent about your product
empty.description: Add your docs site, a PDF or a few short answers. The agent answers from them, and from your help center articles.
empty.tipKb: Published help center articles are already included
empty.tipDrop: Drop a file anywhere on this list to upload it

knowledge.deleteHint: Removes its documents from the agent's knowledge right away.
knowledge.deleteBody: {{name}} and all its documents are removed. The agent stops using them right away.
knowledge.kbNote: Published help center articles are always part of the agent's knowledge.
knowledge.docsComing: Documents appear here as they are found.
knowledge.removeDocBody: The agent stops using this document.
knowledge.removeDocWebsite: The agent stops using this page, and future crawls skip it.
knowledge.name: Name
knowledge.nameHint: How it shows in this list.

website.title: Add a website
website.description: The agent reads pages on this site, starting from its sitemap, and keeps them in sync.
website.urlHint: Pages on the same site are crawled. robots.txt is respected.
website.urlInvalid: Enter a web address, like https://help.example.com
website.includeHint: Leave empty to crawl the whole site.
website.excludeHint: Pages under these paths are left out.
website.weeklyHint: Picks up new and changed pages once a week.

snippet.title: Write a Q&A snippet
snippet.description: A short answer to a question visitors ask, in your words.
snippet.question: Question
snippet.answerPlaceholder: Yes, 50% off Pro with a valid student email. Apply from Billing in the app.

file.title: Upload a file
file.description: The agent reads the text in the file. Scanned pages without a text layer can't be read.
file.drop: Choose a file or drop it here
file.types: PDF, DOCX, TXT, Markdown, HTML or CSV, up to 20 MB
file.wrongType: Use a PDF, DOCX, TXT, Markdown, HTML or CSV file

knowledge.stillAnswering: Still answering from the last sync while this runs

tools.title: Tools
tools.description: Connect your own MCP servers so the agent can look things up and take actions for visitors, like finding an order or updating an address.

empty.title: Give the agent tools
empty.description: Connect an MCP server from your own systems. Its tools show up here, and you decide which ones the agent may use.
empty.tipConfirm: Tools that change things ask the visitor first by default
empty.tipVerified: Limit tools to visitors whose identity your site verified

tools.deleteHint: The agent stops using its tools. Stored credentials are removed.
tools.deleteBody: The agent loses access to the tools of {{name}}. Stored credentials are removed and revoked where the server supports it.
tools.needsAuthToast: {{name}} asks you to sign in. Connect to finish.

oauthFail.oauth_state: The sign-in link expired or was already used. Try again.
oauthFail.not_found: That server was removed before the sign-in finished
oauthFail.provider_error: The server didn't accept the sign-in. Try again.
oauthFail.internal: Couldn't finish the sign-in. Try again.
oauthFail.other: Couldn't connect the server. Try again.

tools.needsAuthBody: It uses OAuth. You'll be sent to the server to approve access, then back here.
tools.noTools: This server doesn't offer any tools.
tools.verifiedOnlyHint: Offered only when your site verified the visitor's identity in the widget.
tools.autoWarning: This tool makes changes and runs without asking the visitor.
tools.addDescription: A remote MCP server over HTTPS. opendesk lists its tools and sends who the visitor is with every call.
tools.name: Name
tools.nameHint: Shown to your team and used in tool names.
tools.urlHint: The MCP endpoint, usually ending in /mcp.

authHint.none: For servers that don't need credentials, or that ask you to sign in after connecting.
authHint.bearer: Sent as Authorization: Bearer on every request.
authHint.header: A custom header with a key, like X-Api-Key.
authHint.oauth: You'll sign in on the server after adding it.

tools.headerInvalid: Use a valid header name. Host, Cookie and Content headers aren't allowed.
tools.replaceHint: The stored value is replaced when you save.
tools.secretHint: Stored encrypted. It isn't shown again.

test.title: Run this tool once
test.jsonOnly: This tool takes structured input, so write its arguments as JSON.
test.notObject: Arguments are a JSON object, like {}
test.failed: The tool answered with an error
test.destructiveNote: This runs for real, whatever the policy.

clients.title: Connect AI clients to opendesk
clients.description: opendesk is an MCP server too. Claude, Cursor, VS Code or any MCP client can search tickets, reply and update them, with the scopes of an API key.
clients.scopes: Send the key as Authorization: Bearer. The client gets exactly the key's scopes.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Chat with the agent as a visitor would. Nothing here reaches a customer or creates a ticket.
playground.emptyBody: Ask what your customers ask. Read-only tools run for real; tools that need confirmation stop at the action card.
playground.try1: How do I reset my password?
playground.handoff: Handed off to your team here
playground.draftBody: Replies follow the edits on the Behaviour page. Save them there when you are happy.
playground.overridesHint: Changes here only affect this playground.
playground.verifiedHint: As if your site signed the visitor in. Unlocks verified-only tools.
playground.note: Each reply costs about {{cost}} on the agent's model, counted as playground usage. Longer conversations and pricier models cost more.

procedures.title: Procedures
procedures.description: Steps Ollie follows for one kind of conversation. Ollie reads a procedure only when a conversation matches its Use this when line.
procedures.limit: A workspace can have up to 50 procedures.
procedures.deleteBody: Ollie stops following {{name}}, and tests that expect it will fail.

empty.title: No procedures yet
empty.description: Write the steps Ollie should follow for one kind of conversation, such as refund requests or bug reports.
empty.tipWhen: Ollie reads one only when a conversation matches it
empty.tipWiki: Copy the steps from a wiki page

editor.name: Name
editor.nameInvalid: Give it a name of up to 80 characters.
editor.whenHint: How Ollie recognises a conversation this is for. Until it picks the procedure, this line is all it sees.
editor.whenPlaceholder: The customer asks for a refund or says they were charged twice
editor.instructionsHint: Markdown. What to ask, what to check, what to say, and when to hand off.
editor.instructionsPlaceholder:
1. Ask for the order number.
2. Look the order up.
3. Hand off refunds over $200.
editor.copyNote: The text is copied once. Nothing stays linked to the page.
editor.channelsHint: Where Ollie may pick it by itself. With neither, only automations run it.
editor.botsHint: Only conversations these bots answer. Leave it empty for every bot.
